mapper.insert: insert into Auct_Board (unum, anum, subject, contents) values (#{unum}, #{anum}, #{subject}, #{contents})
mapper.select: select B.*, U.name, (select count(*) from Auct_Board_Memo M where M.qnum = B.qnum) as memo_cnt from Auct_Board B left join User_List U on B.unum = U.unum where B.anum = #{anum} order by B.qnum desc
select count(*) from Auct_Board where unum = #{unum}
select count(*) from Auct_Board where qnum = #{qnum}
